text:
Maya Patel: heads-up, found an outdated prefetch example in optimize/batching.md that still uses global `kv_prefetch`. opening a small docs PR to switch to route-scoped caching + add concise py/go snippets. will also note short-seq guidance and a tiny migration tip. PR when live: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12801
Alex Chen: great. can you explicitly show settings for sequences <64 tokens? we shifted heuristics there, so recommend `short_seq_mode: true` and show `max_batch_tokens` guidance (example numbers).
Maya Patel: added this draft python snippet in the PR description:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.optimize.update_route_config("chat-route", {
  "batching": {"max_batch_tokens": 1024, "short_seq_mode": True},
  "caching": {"kv_prefetch": {"enabled": True, "prefix_cache_size": 512}}
})
```
Jordan Rivera: small SDK note: Python SDK renamed `update_route_config` in v0.8+, good. please nest `kv_prefetch` under `caching` (you did), and add a one-line comment about eviction scope (route-local).
Maya Patel: added eviction note + anchor to caching.md. Also planning a tiny paragraph: "If you previously enabled global kv_prefetch, migrate to route-scoped caching to avoid cross-route evictions and unpredictable TTLs." one short bullet.
Samir Gupta: can you include a Go snippet for engineers running the private deployment? streaming example would be helpful. show ShortSeqMode and PrefetchCacheSize fields.
Maya Patel: dropped a minimal Go snippet in the PR body:
```go
import "github.com/redwood/inference/sdk"
client := sdk.NewClient()
config := sdk.RouteConfig{
  Batching: sdk.Batching{MaxBatchTokens: 1024, ShortSeqMode: true},
  Caching: sdk.Caching{KVPrefetch: sdk.KVPrefetch{Enabled: true, PrefixCacheSize: 512}},
}
client.UpdateRouteConfig("chat-route", config)
```
DocsBot: docs-pr-checker: running link-checker for PR #12801 (anchors + redirects)
Alex Chen: add a short note about fallback quant profiles: when routing to cheaper fallback models, recommend `qprofile: balanced-16bit` to reduce hallucination risk vs pure 8-bit low-precision. one sentence.
Maya Patel: added fallback quant profile note and linked to docs/optimize/quant-profiles.md. adjusted wording to be doc-friendly. CI link-check passed locally, but docs-pr-checker flagged one anchor: `#kv-prefetch` 404s. i'll add a redirect from batching.md#kv-prefetch -> caching.md#kv-prefetch and update the anchor names to kebab-case.
Jordan Rivera: reviewed Go snippet for naming; left two micro nits (capitalization of PrefetchCacheSize constant and an import path style). overall :thumbsup:. also suggested adding a short example output line showing expected latency improvement for short sequences (e.g., 20-40% less tail latency with short_seq_mode for <64 tokens).
Maya Patel: added the latency note and merged after addressing Jordan's nits. changelog entry used: `docs: replace global prefetch example with route-scoped caching; add short-seq guidance and py/go snippets; add quant profile fallback note; fix kv-prefetch anchor`
Alex Chen: nice work, thanks for the quick fix. :rocket:
